description: When to plant vegetables at a ZIP code, place or coordinates: dates to start seeds indoors, transplant outdoors, direct sow and sow a fall crop, counted from the local median last spring and first fall frost, and whether a warm-season crop fits the frost-free season. Crops: tomato, pepper, eggplant, cucumber, zucchini, pumpkin, watermelon, corn, beans, basil, lettuce, spinach, peas, radish, carrot, beet, broccoli, cabbage, kale, onion, potato, cilantro, garlic. Default all.

crops.description: Crop names, for example ["tomato", "peas", "garlic"]. Default all.

location.description: A US ZIP code ("80202"), a place ("Burlington, VT", "Leeds, UK") or "lat,lon". Add the state or country to a place name to avoid a same-named town.

name: planting_calendar
title: Vegetable planting calendar
